notes.title: Controller and Mac Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Game controllers now work much more reliably
[*] Issues with Apple silicon Macs should be resolved
[/list]

notes.title: Tasty Blue Prequel on Steam Now
notes.content:
We just released the prequel to Tasty Blue on Steam: [url]http://store.steampowered.com/app/445110/[/url]
If you liked Tasty Blue, be sure to check out Tasty Planet: Back for Seconds!

We also just updated Tasty Blue. We fixed a bug which caused the game to "boost" continuously when using a game controller. Now you need to hold down a button to boost. If you feel like you're going slower than you used to, just hold down any button on the game controller to boost. (This makes it easier to control how fast your creature is moving).

We also improved Windows and Mac stability.

notes.title: Controller Support on Mac
notes.content:
Tasty Blue now supports controllers on Mac. We tested PS3 and PS4 controllers and both work great. We've also made other updates to the Mac version to improve compatibility. In addition, there are some small bug fixes for the Windows version of Tasty Blue.

If you have any issues please email us at support@dingogames.com
